name: Fire Bolt
description: Hurl a mote of fire: ranged spell attack, 1d10 fire.

name: Ray of Frost
description: A frigid beam: ranged spell attack, 1d8 cold, and the target's speed drops by 10 ft until your next turn.

name: Shocking Grasp
description: Lightning from your hand: melee spell attack, 1d8 lightning, and the target can't make opportunity attacks until its next turn.

name: Acid Splash
description: A bubble of acid bursts in a 5 ft radius: Dexterity save or 1d6 acid.

name: Chill Touch
description: A ghostly touch: melee spell attack, 1d10 necrotic.

name: Poison Spray
description: A spray of toxic mist: ranged spell attack, 1d12 poison.

name: Eldritch Blast
description: A beam of crackling energy: ranged spell attack, 1d10 force. More beams at levels 5, 11 and 17.

name: Sacred Flame
description: Radiance descends on a foe: Dexterity save or 1d8 radiant.

name: Produce Flame
description: Hurl a flame from your palm: ranged spell attack, 1d8 fire.

name: Vicious Mockery
description: A cutting insult laced with magic: Wisdom save or 1d6 psychic and disadvantage on its next attack roll.

name: Magic Missile
description: Three glowing darts that never miss, 1d4 + 1 force each. One more dart per slot level above 1.

name: Burning Hands
description: A 15 ft cone of flame: Dexterity save, 3d6 fire, half on a success.

name: Thunderwave
description: A 15 ft cube of thunder from you: Constitution save, 2d8 thunder, half on a success. (The push isn't in yet.)

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A flash of light: ranged spell attack, 4d6 radiant, and the next attack against the target has advantage.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: A necrotic touch: Constitution save, 2d10 necrotic, half on a success.

name: Cure Wounds
description: Touch a creature: it regains 2d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP.

name: Healing Word
description: A word of power, Bonus Action, 60 ft: a creature regains 2d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP.

name: Bless
description: Up to three allies add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws. Concentration.

name: Shield of Faith
description: A shimmering field, Bonus Action: one creature gets +2 AC. Concentration.

name: Scorching Ray
description: Three rays of fire, each a ranged spell attack for 2d6 fire. One more ray per slot level above 2.

name: Shatter
description: A ringing burst in a 10 ft radius: Constitution save, 3d8 thunder, half on a success.

name: Hold Person
description: A humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed: it can't act, and hits from within 5 ft are critical. It saves again at the end of each of its turns. Concentration.

name: Misty Step
description: Bonus Action: teleport to a square you can see within 30 ft, without provoking opportunity attacks.

name: Spiritual Weapon
description: Bonus Action: a floating spectral weapon strikes (spell attack, 1d8 + your modifier force), and can strike again as a Bonus Action on later turns. Concentration.
